card.name: Drug-interaction text before substances
card.fires_on: Scattered tokens in drug-interaction and warning text, often partway through a drug name or on a section number like 7.2. The next word is often another drug or substance.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through a drug name, such as nitroimidazole, midazolam or contraindicated.
modes.example: Dose reduction for parenteral midaz<<ol>>am should be considered

modes.label: Interaction section numbers
modes.description: The digit 7 starting an interaction subsection number.

modes.label: Linking words before co-used drugs
modes.description: Small words like and, without or of that lead into other drugs or substances.
modes.example: concurrently taking disulfiram<< and>> nitroimidazole agents

card.writes: It pushes toward words for drugs of abuse and substances, such as marijuana, cocaine and alcohol.
card.plain: It fires in drug-interaction passages where another drug or substance is about to be named.
